BrochureContent.Content:
DNG McCormack present to the market 6 Phelan Street, Rathvilly. No. 6 is a well presented, 3 bedroom, mid-terrace home ideally located in the heart of this popular village setting. Offering bright and spacious accommodation throughout, this property will appeal to first-time buyers, families and investors alike.

The ground floor accommodation comprises an inviting living room, a spacious kitchen/dining area, utility room and guest WC. Upstairs, the property features two double bedrooms, a single bedroom and a family bathroom.

To the rear, the property benefits from a private garden with a patio area and a large lawn section, separated by a shared laneway providing rear access to the terrace houses.

Conveniently located within walking distance of all local amenities in Rathvilly village, this property offers an excellent opportunity to acquire an ideal starter home or investment property in a sought after residential location.

To see current offers or place an offer on this property, register for your myDNG account at mydng.ie.

For further information or to arrange a viewing, contact DNG McCormack Properties on 059 9133800.
